test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. My father is the only breadwinner in the family.

B. My mother happily lends a helping hand in his hard work.

C. I belong to a family where it is difficult to make both ends meet.

D. He earns a rather meager amount, working as a mason.
